name: Around The World... And Beyond! - Music Bingo 4-Pack
title: Around The World... And Beyond! Music Bingo 4-Pack - Road Trip, Cities, Countries & Out of This World
description: Road Trip, Cities, Countries and Out of This World in one download — four travel-themed music bingo games, 250 cards each, with ready-made Spotify and Apple Music playlists.
body:
Four travel-themed music bingo games in one download.

What's included:

  • Road Trip! — everything about getting there.
  • Cities — songs with a city in the title.
  • Countries — name the country the artist is from.
  • Out of This World — space-themed, from "Spaceman!" to "Kryptonite."

Each game prints up to 250 randomized cards and comes with its callsheet and a ready-made Spotify and Apple Music playlist.

Buying all four separately costs $43.96.

name: Party Starter - Music Bingo 4-Pack

description: Four crowd-pleasing music bingo games in one download: Life's A Beach, Stadium Songs, Disco and Food Fight. 250 cards each, with ready-made playlists.
body:
Four games for a room that came to have fun, not to be tested.

name: Punk Rock - 250 Music Bingo Cards
title: Punk Rock Music Bingo - Download And Print 250 Cards
description: Punk Rock music bingo — 250 printable cards of three chords and bad attitudes, with a callsheet and a ready-made playlist. Download, print, play.
body:
Fast, loud and over before anyone gets comfortable — which is exactly how a round should feel.

Answers are song titles in the squares.

Callsheet included.

---------------------------------

We recommend playing about 60 seconds of each song. Go for a Line, 4 Corners, or a Blackout!

Prints up to 250 randomized cards, two to a sheet of letter paper.

name: "Things In Songs" Music Bingo 5-Pack
title: Things In Songs Music Bingo 5-Pack - Five Games, 250 Cards Each
description: Five music bingo games hiding everyday words in their titles: Colors, Body Parts, Food Fight, Zoo Rock, and Numbers. 250 printable cards each.
body:
What song has a color in the title? An animal? A body part?

Five games, five categories of songs hiding everyday words in their titles — Colors, Body Parts, Food Fight, Zoo Rock, and Numbers. Your crowd will swear they know them all until they're stuck on the third row.

What's included:

  • Colors — a color in the title.
  • Body Parts — a body part in the title.
  • Food Fight — something you eat or drink.
  • Zoo Rock — an animal in the title.
  • Numbers — a number in the title.

Each game prints up to 250 unique cards, no repeats, with a callsheet and a ready-made Spotify and Apple Music playlist. Download, print, play.
